title: Chain Tensionner
description: Custom chain tensionner assembly for our TIM09 ethanol-powered car — designed, simulated, manufactured and tested.
fullDescription:
I designed, simulated, manufactured and tested a chain tensionner assembly design for our TIM09 ethanol-powered car. Our previous chain tensionner was a makeshift attempt at a short-term fix that was sufficient at the time, but lacked intentional purpose, was too heavy and not properly designed or fabricated.

I therefore chose an elegant, simple, lightweight and cheap design that was extensively tested in FEM analysis using SimScale, and then manufactured it almost entirely myself. Some of the parts were fabricated on the lathe in materials such as Brass and Aluminium, while others were draped in carbon fiber and vacuum-sealed.

title: Connecting Rod
description: Custom connecting rod manufactured on a 3-axis mill with a purpose-built support fixture.
fullDescription:
I manufactured a connecting rod for a new engine my team and I are in the process of building on a 3-axis mill. To enable precise and repeatable manufacturing, I designed and fabricated a custom support fixture.

This support allows for accurate positioning and clamping of the rod during machining operations, and enables the production of multiple connecting rods if necessary.

title: Intake Bellmouth
description: Redesigning the intake bellmouth through parametric design and CFD simulation.
fullDescription:
I'm currently in the process of redesigning the intake bellmouth for our team's engine. This project involves parametric design, extensive CFD simulations to find the optimal shape for our specific needs, and then manufacturing the carbon fiber bellmouth including its mold.

I expect this project to take a little while in order for it to exceed both my team's and my own expectations and needs.
